title.fa: کسروی: نقد اروپایی‌گری و واکنش خشونت‌بار به پاکدینی
title.en: Kasravi: critique of Europeanism and the violent backlash to Pak-dini
title.nl: Kasravi: kritiek op Europeanisme en de gewelddadige reactie op Pak-dini

summary.fa: کسروی اروپایی‌شدن کامل را راه درست ایران نمی‌دانست و در سال‌های ۱۳۲۰ جنبش خود را در برابر روحانیت و بخشی از نخبگان قرار داد؛ پیشگفتار ویراستار این کتاب پیامدهای آن، از جمله سوءقصد ۱۳۲۴ و قتل او در ۱۳۲۴ را روایت می‌کند.
summary.en: Kasravi rejected wholesale Europeanisation as Iran's path and set his movement against the clergy and parts of the elite in the 1940s. The editor's preface of this edition narrates the backlash, including the 1945 attack on him and his 1946 assassination.
summary.nl: Kasravi wees volledige verwestersing af en kwam in de jaren 1940 in conflict met geestelijkheid en deel van de elite; het voorwoord beschrijft de tegenreactie.

text.fa: کسروی می‌گوید در دورهٔ پیش از نوشتن «آیین» شیفتگی ایرانیان به اروپا بیش از اندازه بود و باور او آن است که اروپا در راه زندگی گمراه است و شرقیان نباید از آن تقلید کنند.
text.en: Kasravi says Iranians were infatuated with Europe and urges them not to imitate it, since Europe, in his view, is itself misguided about how to live.
text.nl: Kasravi says Iranians were infatuated with Europe and urges them not to imitate it, since Europe, in his view, is itself misguided about how to live.

text.fa: او مشروطه/دموکراسی را «بهترین شکل حکومت» می‌شمارد، ولی باور دارد توده معنای آن را نمی‌داند؛ این باور او را از نخبگان غربگرا و از روحانیان هر دو جدا می‌کرد.
text.en: He calls constitutional rule or democracy the best form of government but thinks the public does not grasp it - a stance that put him at odds with both Westernising elites and clergy.
text.nl: He calls constitutional rule or democracy the best form of government but thinks the public does not grasp it - a stance that put him at odds with both Westernising elites and clergy.

text.fa: پیشگفتار ویراستار آگاهی می‌دهد که پرسش‌وپاسخ‌ها مربوط به روزهای پس از سوءقصد به کسروی (اردیبهشت ۱۳۲۴) است و او را پیشتاز نبرد با خرافه معرفی می‌کند؛ این پیشگفتار جانبدارانه و از سوی پیروان اوست.
text.en: The editor's preface, from his sympathisers, says the dialogues date from just after the April 1945 attack on him and frames him as a pioneer against superstition; it is partisan.
text.nl: The editor's preface, from his sympathisers, says the dialogues date from just after the April 1945 attack on him and frames him as a pioneer against superstition; it is partisan.

text.fa: پژوهش دانشگاهی کسروی را اندیشمندی مهم در ایران معاصر می‌داند که ملی‌گرایی عقل‌گرا، نقد دین‌های رایج و اصلاح زبان را به هم پیوند زد. او در اسفند ۱۳۲۴ (۱۹۴۶) در کاخ دادگستری تهران توسط اعضای فدائیان اسلام کشته شد و میراث او هنوز محل اختلاف است.
text.en: Academic work treats Kasravi as an important figure of modern Iran who joined rationalist nationalism, critique of existing religions and language reform. He was assassinated in 1946 by Fada'iyan-e Islam members, and his legacy remains divisive.
text.nl: Academic work treats Kasravi as an important figure of modern Iran who joined rationalist nationalism, critique of existing religions and language reform. He was assassinated in 1946 by Fada'iyan-e Islam members, and his legacy remains divisive.

text.fa: روش کسروی بیشتر جدلی است تا پژوهش داوری‌شده؛ ادعاهای او دربارهٔ تاریخ، اروپا و ادیان را باید دیدگاه او شمرد و با پژوهش دانشگاهی سنجید.
text.en: Kasravi's method is polemical rather than peer-reviewed; his claims about history, Europe and religions should be read as his viewpoint and checked against scholarship.
text.nl: Kasravi's method is polemical rather than peer-reviewed; his claims about history, Europe and religions should be read as his viewpoint and checked against scholarship.
